model.formula: annual burden hours = min(round(hours per run × annual cycles × 55% attribution share), available capacity hours)
model.attribution_formula: fixed 55 percent of supplied coordination hours
model.capacity_formula: people impacted × 1,800 available hours per person per year
model.capacity_limit_rule: cap annual burden hours at total available capacity hours
model.annual_cost_formula: round(annual burden hours × supplied average hourly cost)
model.capacity_drag_formula: round(annual burden hours ÷ total available capacity hours × 100), bounded to 1–100%
model.recoverable_share_formula: interpolate within the score-band range using the worst measured institutional burden severity
model.note: The 55% attribution is an explicit instrument assumption applied consistently to pathway sizing, not an observed time study or empirical comparison sample.
